purpose: Prove that natural model stop is only accepted after a supervised Tool Result satisfies the required obligation.
expected_sequence: Model proposes one Stata Tool Call
Tool Call crosses JIT Admission and creates exactly one Operation
Operation and Completion Manifest reach completed state
hard_invariants: No Operation exists without a Tool Admission.
The Operation identity referenced by Admission is the executed Operation.
The canonical Tool Result belongs to the admitted Tool Call.
The Stop Guard decision is no earlier than the successful Tool Result.
The Turn cannot be succeeded while required goal coverage is incomplete.
